family_decision: Preserve the existing San Antonio itinerary's indoor/weather pivot while keeping a near-departure forecast short-lived and unknown on failed or expired data.
hypothesis: A deterministic exact-scope API adapter can preserve source/grid/time/unit/null provenance and fail closed without changing public facts or adding an LLM/service.

primary_sources.capture_gap: First successful capture used legacy generic forecast names and omitted current12h definitions. Current names were learned; scope amendment registered before one additional exactsame documentation request, preserving first immutable journal. Not a denied-access retry or a new origin.
primary_sources.field_result: Current definitions distinguish generatedAt/updateTime/validTimes/periods; temperature supports integer or QuantitativeValue and separate deprecated F/C unit; probabilityOfPrecipitation is QuantitativeValue. Units/nulls/dates are checked conservatively, not a complete OpenAPI validator.

primary_sources.summary: Private pilot expiry accounts for Date, Age and response delay; conflicting/invalid explicit validity is held. No heuristic or stale cache serving is implemented; not a full RFC-compliant cache service.

confidence: High for inspected schema, exact two native retrievals and controlled parsing/expiry behavior. One city/one captured forecast is not full-schema, global coverage, public usefulness or operational reliability proof.
reusable_lesson: A source's open-data policy and successful schema GET do not prove a working forecast adapter. Observe exact variants, preserve failures and qualify live access separately; field expiry is independent of weekly page maintenance.
falsification_trigger: Wrong location/grid or source dates admitted; null becomes zero/dry; explicit expiry ignored; duplicate or missing attempt is replayed; source instruction executes; predictions become safety or published facts; original source holds or public verification clocks change.
